name: deprecate-ladybug-store
description: Extracts the Ladybug graph-store implementation and its ownership to the independent specd-plugin-graphstore-ladybug project, leaving @specd/code-graph with SQLite as its sole built-in backend. The change preserves the additive graph-store factory seam for future plugins and aligns Code Graph CLI commands with the SDK-managed provider lifecycle.
